figures.caption: Fig. 2. Mechanism analysis of MRUF. Scatter plots of predicted uncertainty log(σ2 m) versus the final modality gate gm for language, vision, and audio under clean, drop, and Gaussian perturbation conditions. A negative relationship indicates that modalities with higher predicted uncertainty tend to receive lower fusion weights.
